Session Storage Persist Behavior

Session Storage Persist is a Persist behavior that writes committed FeatureCell state to browser sessionStorage during the Persist stage. It provides tab-scoped persistence suitable for transient state that must survive page reloads but should not persist across browser restarts.

This behavior observes the finalized pipeline output after all upstream processing—including resolve, merge, operators, filters, and reducers—has completed. The received value represents the authoritative, reduced state and is serialized and stored using a feature-scoped, namespaced sessionStorage key.

Session Storage Persist does not transform values, emit snapshots, or influence pipeline control flow. Its role is limited strictly to persistence and hydration of finalized state in a predictable, fail-safe manner.

Storage Characteristics

Browser sessionStorage provides storage scoped to the lifetime of a single browser tab. Stored values persist across page reloads within the same tab but are cleared automatically when the tab is closed. Unlike cookies, session storage values are not transmitted with network requests.

When the persisted state is undefined, the associated sessionStorage entry is removed entirely. When a valid value is present, it is serialized using JSON.stringify and written directly to storage under the FeatureCell’s scoped key.

Execution Semantics

Session Storage Persist executes synchronously within the Persist stage. Storage writes and removals occur inline and complete before the pipeline proceeds. All errors during serialization or storage access are caught and logged without interrupting pipeline execution.

Note

Session Storage persistence is ideal for ephemeral UI flows such as wizards, progress tracking, or temporary interaction state. It is not intended for durable application data or values that must survive full browser restarts. For long-lived persistence requirements, a Local Storage persist behavior should be used instead.

Diagrams
Configuration

Session Storage Persist does not accept runtime configuration options. Its behavior is fully defined and deterministic, providing synchronous serialization, storage, and fail-safe execution by default.

Configuration consists solely of attaching or removing the persist behavior from a FeatureCell. When present, the behavior automatically participates in the Persist stage and observes the finalized pipeline output.

When the finalized state value is undefined, the associated sessionStorage entry is removed automatically. When a value is present, it is serialized using JSON.stringify and written under a feature-scoped, namespaced key.

Session Storage Persist may be freely stacked with other persist behaviors. When multiple persist behaviors are configured, each is invoked sequentially with the same final pipeline value.

Examples

Example 1: Use the Session Storage Persist Behavior in a FeatureCell

This example demonstrates a FeatureCell configured with the withSessionStoragePersistBehavior . When state updates are committed via mergeState, the finalized FeatureCell value is written to sessionStorage during the Persist stage.

Session Storage Persist observes the fully reduced pipeline output and performs persistence as a side effect. It does not transform values, influence merge semantics, or participate in pipeline control flow.

Note

Persist behaviors operate after all upstream stages—including resolve, merge, operators, filters, and reducers—have completed. Multiple persist behaviors may be attached to a FeatureCell and will be executed sequentially. 

{{`// app.config.ts

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideVault({ logLevel: 'off' }),

    provideFeatureCell(
      EmployeeService
      {
        key: 'employees',
        initialState: []
      },
      [
        // Attach sessionStorage-based persistence
        withSessionStoragePersistBehavior
      ]
    )
  ]
};

// bank-employee.service.ts

import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FeatureCell, injectVault } from '@sdux-vault/angular';
import { Employee } from './employee.shape';

@FeatureCell<Employee[]>('employees')
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class EmployeeService {
  readonly vault = injectVault<Employee[]>(EmployeeService);

  constructor() {
    this.vault.initialize();
  }

  addEmployee(): void {
    // Final state is persisted to sessionStorage
    this.vault.mergeState({
      value: [{ id: 1, name: 'Jane Doe' }]
    });
  }
}`}}
 
{{`export const employeeCell = FeatureCell<Employee[]>(
  {
    key: 'employees',
    initialState: [],
  },
  [
    // Attach sessionStorage-based persistence
    withSessionStoragePersistBehavior
  ]
);

// Initialize the FeatureCell
employeeCell.initialize();

// Commit state and persist to sessionStorage
employeeCell.mergeState({
  value: [{ id: 1, name: 'Jane Doe' }]
});`}}

  {

// Initialize the FeatureCell
employeeCell.initialize();

// Commit state and persist to sessionStorage
